about: Expected results for the ghalam corpus (methodology, section 8). A finding counts as found when the scanner reports any of its 'where' locations; a location without a line matches any finding in that file. 'category' is checked once findings carry category codes.

findings.title: Demo credentials shown on the sign-in form and used as defaults
No HTTPS, session cookie sent with secure => false
Employee sign-in has no brute-force protection and no MFA
Errors are shown to the user (no php.ini, no exception handler)
The application connects as the PostgreSQL superuser; DDL on every request
Employee actions are not logged
Link password lockout: race condition, IP rotation, proxy DoS
Documents are not encrypted at rest, no integrity hash, no antivirus
No deletion, retention or backups
No Cache-Control: no-store on the password page and the file response
No idle or absolute session timeout, use_strict_mode off
No roles or object owner checks (IDOR with a second employee)
Link and password are shown together and end up in one channel
File name, size and expiry visible before the password
Token in the query string ends up in access logs and history
password_hash (bcrypt) runs on every request for the seed admin
No CSP, inline onclick handler
Expiry computed in PHP without a time zone, stored as TIMESTAMPTZ
findings.note: The manual review rated this medium assuming PHP has no time zone. The KB check on php:8.3-apache (24.11.2026) showed date.timezone defaults to UTC, as does PostgreSQL, so the times are correct today and break only when one zone changes: the scanner reports it as low.

findings.title: Containers not hardened, images not pinned by digest
Scanner reports with an internal IP are not excluded in .gitignore
Logout through GET (CSRF logout)
Account enumeration by response time
Link built from the Host header
No account management: password change, policy, disabling
No disk quotas
Link password is 48 bits
Link and password kept in plain text in the session file

confirmed.title: Prepared PDO statements, no SQL injection
Output escaped with e() and ENT_QUOTES
File type detected by content (finfo) with an allow list
Files stored outside DocumentRoot under a random name, directory 0700
192-bit link token, link password stored with bcrypt
Atomic UPDATE ... WHERE download_count < max_downloads in a transaction
nosniff, X-Frame-Options and Referrer-Policy: no-referrer headers; TXT served as attachment
.env excluded from git, database published only on 127.0.0.1
